neighbours.label: the token right before a 5 that the text makes predictable, in two ways: a number being copied from earlier in the text (on the token before its 5), and a counting run in digits or words whose next item is 5 ('… four,'); copies with a different digit there, and counting runs whose next item is another number, stay quiet

The waiter called table 15
Gate 25 is closing. Final call for gate 2
Serial 4152 was logged. Logged again: serial 415
Dial extension 1254, and if busy, dial 12
The children shouted together: one, two, three, four,
She counted the steps out loud, two, three, four,
quiet:

neighbours.notes: Found in the copy-only digit screen, then probed: copy before a 5 0.39, counting to five in words 0.31, in digits 0.20; copy with another digit 0.07, a count past 5 0.13. The same two-route profile as the held predictable-3, -6 and -8 units at layer 35 (L35/N6726-, L35/N1376+, L35/N7741-); those have copy-only feeders at layer 34.

predictions: >= 6/8 fire (counting in digits may be weaker); near misses < 0.2
